news.headline: Abivax Announces Positive Pre-NDA Interaction with the FDA for Obefazimod
news.summary: Abivax completed a constructive pre-NDA meeting with the FDA, achieving alignment on the planned content, format, and strategy for its obefazimod New Drug Application in ulcerative colitis. The company confirmed it remains on track to submit the NDA by the end of 2026.

news.headline: Morgan Stanley Raises Abivax Price Target to $180, Maintains Overweight
news.summary: Morgan Stanley lifted its price target on Abivax to $180 from $132 while keeping an Overweight rating, citing confidence in obefazimod's ulcerative colitis commercial prospects following the maintenance data and capital raise.

news.headline: Abivax Strengthens Commercial Capabilities With Strategic Leadership Appointments
news.summary: Abivax named four senior commercial executives -- covering marketing, patient services, sales, commercial operations, and market access -- as it builds out the organization needed for a potential independent US launch of obefazimod ahead of the planned Q4 2026 NDA filing.

news.headline: Abivax Share Momentum Builds Amid Renewed Takeover Speculation
news.source: Yahoo Finance / La Lettre (via financial press)
news.summary: French outlet La Lettre reported Abivax re-engaged M&A advisor Centerview amid renewed acquisition interest, reigniting takeover chatter around the company even as it pushes ahead with its own US commercialization plans.

news.headline: Abivax Announces Closing of Upsized $920 Million Public Offering
news.summary: Abivax closed its underwritten public offering of 7.36 million ADSs after underwriters fully exercised their option, generating roughly $920 million gross ($874.1 million net) proceeds. Combined with existing cash, this is expected to fund operations into Q4 2029.

news.headline: Abivax Stock Soars After New ABTECT Maintenance Data Eases Safety Concerns
news.summary: An expanded Part 2 dataset from the ABTECT maintenance trial showed malignancy rates in line with normal background rates for the patient population, resolving the cancer-signal scare that had hit the stock in early June and driving a sharp rebound.

catalysts.label: First NDA submission to FDA (obefazimod, ulcerative colitis)
catalysts.detail: Following a positive pre-NDA meeting with the FDA on July 30, 2026, Abivax reaffirmed it is on track to submit its first New Drug Application for obefazimod in moderately to severely active ulcerative colitis by year-end 2026 (guided as Q4 2026).

catalysts.label: MAA submission to EMA (obefazimod, ulcerative colitis)
catalysts.detail: Abivax has guided toward filing a Marketing Authorization Application with European regulators in the second half of 2026 alongside the US NDA process.

catalysts.label: H1 2026 financial results
catalysts.detail: Abivax's half-year 2026 financial results and corporate update remain scheduled for September 21, 2026 per the company's investor-relations financial calendar; no change to this date has been reported as of early August 2026.

catalysts.label: ENHANCE-CD Phase 2b induction data (Crohn's disease)
catalysts.detail: Topline 12-week induction-phase results from the ENHANCE-CD Phase 2b trial of obefazimod in Crohn's disease are guided for mid-2027, which would be the next major pipeline expansion catalyst beyond ulcerative colitis.

catalysts.label: Takeover / M&A speculation
catalysts.detail: Recurring reports (La Lettre and others, plus earlier reports of Eli Lilly interest) of renewed acquirer interest and Abivax's re-engagement of advisor Centerview keep M&A speculation alive, though no formal offer or process has been confirmed by the company.

catalysts.label: Potential US/EU approval and commercial launch
catalysts.detail: Assuming a smooth regulatory review following the 2026 NDA/MAA filings, Abivax is building out its commercial organization (four senior hires announced July 23, 2026) and positioning for a potential independent US launch of obefazimod around 2027, funded by the $920M raise.

pulse: Abivax heads into mid-August 2026 trading firmly above its June lows after the FDA gave positive pre-NDA feedback on July 30, confirming the company remains on track to file its obefazimod NDA for ulcerative colitis by year-end 2026. Management is visibly building out for an independent US launch -- closing a $920 million offering in early July and adding four senior commercial executives on July 23 -- while persistent takeover chatter (Centerview re-engagement, earlier reports of Eli Lilly interest) keeps M&A optionality alive alongside that solo path. The next scheduled milestone is the H1 2026 financial results on September 21, 2026, ahead of the formal NDA and EU MAA filings expected later in H2 2026.
